meta.title: Kaipu Wisdom Team
meta.description: Companion sidebar panel for the Kaipu site plugin: shows the built-in expert team, the scenes they serve, and seat status. ★ Must be installed alongside kaipu-platform — seat data is provided by the site plugin through the host gateway; installed alone it truthfully reports "channel not ready". ★ Fully removable: uninstall it and the site plugin stays complete.
